hints.title: Cable Count Sufficiency
hints.text: To connect n computers into one component, you need at least n - 1 cables. If connections.length < n - 1, return -1.

hints.title: Count Connected Components
hints.text: Use disjoint set union or graph traversal to find the number of connected components C in the network.

hints.title: Required Redundant Cables
hints.text: Because total cables >= n - 1, there are enough redundant cables to join all components. The answer is always C - 1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding topology from scratch is unnecessary when counting components suffices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Disjoint Set Union with path compression checks redundancy and counts components near-linearly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate immediately checks E >= n - 1 and calculates (components - 1).
complexity.notes: Each union operation of distinct sets decreases component count by 1.
